svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Kinetic — Gym App Home Screen (iOS)
svg.desc: Dark-mode iOS home screen: status bar with Dynamic Island, greeting header with avatar and notification badge, Activity Rings hero card with Move/Exercise/Stand progress, three metric tiles, Today's Session card with primary play action, Weekly Volume bar chart, Programs section, and a four-item tab bar with home indicator.

g.text: On pace to close all three rings by 6:40 PM
